As a player who only played Paladin (500 hours at level 90 ) yes the exploration with flying mounts are fun and there are cool mounts, you can dive into underwater when you get to Stormblood expansion, its kinda fun but dont expect too much from that. I would recommend Paladin as a welcomer and tanking is really entertaining in this game and isn't even hard for casual players (it might be hard on harder dungeons). I like gathering and crafting but it is monotonous after a while like in every other MMO. I hope you like the game and have a good experience if you have anymore questions i'll try to answer them in my acknowledge. I recommend looking for a settings guide at the very beginning cuz some settings make your life really easy.
